text:
hana: Quick sync — found a couple of small but blocking UX/a11y issues in the SLO threshold compact row. When you open the channel preview (the small tray) keyboard users can't tab back to the action chips; screen readers also announce the channel count as 'button' not as a descriptive sentence. Can we triage?

piotr: Thanks — can you paste repro steps and which browser/AT you used?

hana: repro: SLOs → Edit threshold → focus the compact action row → activate the eye preview (space/enter). The preview slides in as a tray from the right. Try Shift+Tab: focus stays inside the tray and never reaches the action chips (Assign owner / Pause alerts / Fallback policy). Tested with VoiceOver on macOS and Chrome+NVDA.

meera: I can repro on NVDA. The tray is implemented with a focus trap and the action chips live outside the trap. Short-term fix: add a keyboard-only "Skip to actions" control at the top of the tray that moves focus to #threshold-actions. Long-term we should consider rendering the action row inside the tray DOM.

toni: Copy nit: the compact toggle currently says "Mute" which is ambiguous. Product prefers "Pause alerts" visually. For SRs we should add an aria-describedby with a short sentence like: "Pause alerts for this SLO for the selected duration." That keeps visual brevity and SR clarity.

aria-bot: Accessibility bot: tray element lacks aria-labelledby and role=dialog/region; header isn't announced. Also, the channel count span is announced as a button because of markup; recommend: change markup to a plain span with aria-live="polite" and text e.g. "Preview — 3 channels configured" so it reads naturally. Ensure aria-describedby id exists and precedes the control in DOM.

hana: Good call. For the skip link we should make it visible on keyboard focus (sr-only but focusable) and ensure the target (#threshold-actions) has tabindex=-1 for programmatic focus.

piotr: Implementation plan: 1) inject a focusable skip link into the tray when it mounts; 2) add role=dialog + aria-labelledby to tray header; 3) swap the button-markup for channel-count to span + aria-live; 4) change toggle to real button with aria-pressed and aria-describedby referencing hidden text. I'll open a small PR with these 4 items.

meera: Tests: add Cypress e2e for keyboard flow: Tab to eye → open tray → Shift+Tab should land on action chips → Activate Pause alerts → assert aria-pressed toggles and aria-live announced the new channel count. Also add a VoiceOver smoke test in accessibility checklist.

toni: On microcopy: change 'Fallback' → 'Fallback policy' and 'Assign' → 'Assign owner' to be explicit for assistive tech. Keep the visible labels as short as possible.

ux-bot: Design note: updating the compact row component tokens to include a11y-friendly variants (sr-description ids and shortened labels). I'll add a snippet to the design-system docs with code example and expected AT behavior.

piotr: FYI I'll also include a small CSS rule for .sr-focusable { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: auto; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; } .sr-focusable:focus { left: 16px; top: 12px; width: auto; height: auto; } so keyboard users see the skip link.

hana: Thanks — prioritizing the skip-link + role/labeling + toggle semantics + copy swaps for the next patch. Follow-up: refactor to move action row into tray DOM in a later PR.

meera: I'll volunteer to run the NVDA/VoiceOver pass on staging when the PR lands.

toni: Great — tag me for copy review.

hana: Closing once merged. :sparkles:
